checkpoints.question: Why should a second publisher use `__node:=talker_two` or another distinct node name?
checkpoints.model_answer: A second publisher should use a distinct node name so node-specific tooling identifies it unambiguously. Duplicate names are allowed, but they can make node-specific tools ambiguous and have unintended side effects.

evidence.label: Give a second publisher a distinct node name

checkpoints.question: Why must both the publisher and subscriber remap `chatter:=greeting`?
checkpoints.model_answer: Both endpoints must refer to the same topic. Remapping only one leaves the publisher and subscriber on different names.

evidence.label: Remap both ends of a topic
